bullets.text: 5G SA Launch in Manchester - **Virgin Media O2** activates 5G SA, enhancing connectivity for over 589,000 residents.
£100M Investment in AI Chips - **Fractile** expands UK operations, boosting the AI hardware ecosystem significantly.
AI-Driven Network Management - Intent-Based Networking simplifies network configurations using AI and natural language processing.
Vodafone's Private 5G Progress - **Vodafone Business** reports nearly 200 private 5G deployments, aiming for enterprise-friendly solutions.
AI-RRM Enhances Wi-Fi 7 - AI-driven Radio Resource Management optimizes Wi-Fi networks for better performance in dense environments.
WPA3 Security Challenges - WPA3 adoption in multi-dwelling units faces significant interoperability and implementation issues.
Private 5G Deployment Issues - Space constraints hinder the rollout of private 5G networks in many environments.
BT Group Leadership Changes - **BT Group** announces executive shifts to strengthen leadership in Openreach and BT International.
Samsung's AI-Ready Networks - **Samsung** promotes virtualized architectures to enable AI capabilities in telecom infrastructure.
6G's New Role - Future networks may integrate sensing capabilities, transforming infrastructure into a data-rich environment.
